red: a color at the end of the spectrum next to orange and opposite violet
blue: the color of the clear sky and the deep sea
green: the color of growing foliage between yellow and blue in the spectrum
color: a property possessed by an object producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects or emits light
light: the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible
eye: the organ of sight in humans and animals
